Name: ChillInYourFarmHouse
Author: Husky110
Description:
This is just a small mod.
I was unable to find a good farmmap with a pool of some sort, where to regenerate stamina and the other mods felt too much like cheating to me (unlimited stamina...).
And since Custom Farm Types didn't get an update in a while, I came up with my own mod.
ChillInYourFarmHouse let's you regain stamina after you've entered your farmhouse.
It will check how much stamina you have left and will regain based on that. Every 10 ingame-minutes in your farmhouse will give you either 5 or 10 percent back, based on how much stamina you have left. A full recover (from 0 to 100%) takes about 2 ingame-hours.
ChillInYourFarmHouse will NOT cure exhaustion!
You can move arround and do stuff, while taking a break from everything.

The source is maintained at [url=https://github.com/Husky110/ChillInYourFarmHouse]GitHub[/url]﻿.

As of 2019-02-15 Mizzion took over the maintaining of the mod. Cudos to him! :)
